subject: Strange error when sub-setting data with respect to dates "refMethodDef"

messages.author: c1d956e2355f9e90
messages.subject: Strange error when sub-setting data with respect to dates "refMethodDef"
parts:
I re-posted this topic I wanted to make some corrections.

The specific error is.
"Error : ggplot2 doesn't know how to deal with data of class refMethodDef"

But I believe that shiny is the actual culprit of the error.


I have narrowed down the cause of the error to be in this piece of code
rangesub<- reactive({
    dataset1 <- dataset()
    origin <- "1970-01-01 00:00:00"
    origin.fmt <- "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S"
    time <- as.POSIXct(origin, format=origin.fmt, tz="GMT")
    
    ########## In Range Functionality #######             
          starttime1 <- reactive(c(paste(input$sy,input$sm,input$sd, sep = "-")))
          endtime1 <- reactive(c(paste(input$ey,input$em,input$ed, sep = "-")))
          start <-as.numeric(as.POSIXct(starttime1()))+time
          end<- as.numeric(as.POSIXct(endtime1()))+time    
          
          dataset1 <-reactive(subset(dataset1, dataset1$PeaksP1Time >= input$start & dataset1$PeaksP1Time <= input$end))
#             dataset$PeaksP1Time <- dataset$PeaksP1Time + time

})

When I run my app and  print "rangesub()" I get this
function () 
{
    .dependents$register()

        .self$.updateValue()
    }
    if (identical(class(.value), "try-error")) 
        stop(attr(.value, "condition"))
    if (.visible) 
        .value
    else invisible(.value)
}

I have no idea what to make of this. I know that this code will run because when I remove its reactive functionality ... Like such
origin <- "1970-01-01 00:00:00"
origin.fmt <- "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S"
time <- as.POSIXct(origin, format=origin.fmt, tz="GMT")
starttime1 <- "2011-12-1"
endtime1 <- "2013-1-1"
start <-as.numeric(as.POSIXct(starttime1))+time
end<- as.numeric(as.POSIXct(endtime1))+time
dataset1 <- subset(df, df$PeaksP1Time >= start & df$PeaksP1Time <= end)
dataset1$PeaksP1Time <- dataset1$PeaksP1Time + time

ggplot(dataset1, aes(PeaksP1Time, PeaksP1, color = Device_ID)) + 
  geom_point(size=3)

I get this lovely graphic

My apologies for some of the formatting issues.I tried attaching my work space but I kept getting  "error 340" but i can upload a CSV file of a sample data set if requested.


Any help would be greatly appreciated and hopefully this isn't a stupid question. Thank you!

messages.subject: Re: Strange error when sub-setting data with respect to dates "refMethodDef"
parts: I replaced the code as you said. The error was in in the sub setting function. It did not need to be a reactive function. The code that works looks like this.

dataset1<-subset(dataset1, dataset1$PeaksP1Time >= start & dataset1$PeaksP1Time <= end)

I can't wait to post this on gist and show people my work!
